answer: Mount Morgan: closure year 1990 is the latest End Year in the MINOCC 2017 MineHist table for this site (MINOCC-2017:MineHist:494270:6): the last recorded period of working ended then, which says when working last ended, not why; other sources give 1990 (QLDGOV-MM), 1981 (WP-MM), 1927 (WP-MM), not used here. Gold in 1990 averaged US$383.5/oz nominal (mean of the World Bank Pink Sheet monthly averages for the year; 12 months; A$492.2 nominal). In 2026-10 US dollars that is US$990.64/oz (US CPI-U, 1990 average 130.658 against 337.511). Gold in 2026-10 averaged US$4105/oz, 4.14 times the closure-year price in today's dollars. US-dollar purchasing power (US CPI-U); not an Australian-dollar figure. CPI snapshot taken 2026-11-21.
